ICS 75.080PCD 01New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThe Indian Standard (Part 185) which is identical with ISO 20823 : 2003 ‘Petroleum and related products - Determination of the flammability characteristics of fluids in contact with hot surfaces - Manifold ignition test’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on recommendation of the Methods for Sampling and Test for Petroleum and Related Products of Synthetic or Biological Origin including Lubricants, Greases, Speciality Products, Additives and Gaseous Fuels (excluding Bitumen) Sectional Committee and approval of the Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Division Council.
